intro.text: A purpose-built shelter used by the trappers who work the islands of the Pantheon.

description.text: A trapper keeps several on the island he works, hidden in remote spots and ringed with traps to deter rivals. They are made to keep out deadly animals and insects, though not perfectly sealed. Trappers sleep in them, as nowhere else on an island is safe, and keep Aviar there; some of the birds help hide a camp from predators such as nightmaws that hunt by sensing minds.

A camp holds basic supplies like blankets, dishes and antivenom. One example is a single cramped room built up in a gurratree, about four paces across, with netted windows, a trapdoor in the floor and a ladder to a hatch in the roof, where nesting boxes let breeding Aviar come and go.

Usually only its own trapper knows where a camp is, unless he is teaching an apprentice. Trappers write their camps and traps down in notebooks, so that if they die another trapper can find their birds and look after them.
